description: Python checks the conditions from top to bottom and runs only the first block whose condition is true.
The four spaces before a line show which `if`, loop or function it belongs to.
`for` takes each item of a list, string or range in turn; `range(a, b)` counts from `a` up to `b - 1`.
`enumerate` pairs each item with its position from 0; `zip` walks several lists together and stops at the shortest.
`break` leaves the loop at once; `continue` skips to the next item.
